definitions: Any of several highly venomous, arboreal snakes of the genus Dendroaspis, native to tropical Africa.
A brand of chewy fruit-flavored candy.
A type of fast, agile, and often aggressive warship or aircraft.
examples: The black mamba is one of Africa's most feared snakes.
She bought a pack of Mamba candies at the store.
The Mamba fighter jet performed an impressive aerial display.
